directions.label: Perimeter Shooting
directions.plain: More shooting pulls the list toward elite three-point shooters; less shooting pulls it toward slashers and drivers.
directions.derivation: Skill-difference vector: mean 64-d embedding of rows graded >=90 in Perimeter Shooting minus mean of rows graded <=10, from skills.json (1,297 high rows, 1,424 low rows).

directions.label: Playmaking
directions.plain: More playmaking pulls the list toward pass-first floor generals; less pulls it toward finishers who play off the ball.
directions.derivation: Skill-difference vector: mean 64-d embedding of rows graded >=90 in Playmaking minus mean of rows graded <=10, from skills.json (1,297 high rows, 1,424 low rows).

directions.label: Rim Protection
directions.plain: More rim protection pulls the list toward shot-blockers and bigs; less pulls it toward perimeter players.
directions.derivation: Skill-difference vector: mean 64-d embedding of rows graded >=90 in Rim Protection minus mean of rows graded <=10, from skills.json (1,297 high rows, 1,424 low rows).

directions.label: Scoring Volume
directions.plain: More scoring pulls the list toward high-volume bucket-getters; less pulls it toward lower-usage role players.
directions.derivation: Skill-difference vector: mean 64-d embedding of rows graded >=90 in Scoring Volume minus mean of rows graded <=10, from skills.json (1,297 high rows, 1,424 low rows).

directions.label: Offensive Glass
directions.plain: More offensive rebounding pulls the list toward glass-crashers; less pulls it toward players who leak out instead of crashing.
directions.derivation: Skill-difference vector: mean 64-d embedding of rows graded >=90 in Offensive Glass minus mean of rows graded <=10, from skills.json (1,297 high rows, 1,424 low rows).

directions.label: Glass + Rim bigs
directions.plain: Blending toward this archetype center turns the player into a paint big: boards, blocks, and interior finishing take over the list.
directions.derivation: Archetype-centroid direction: mtnn_meta.json centroid 0 minus the global mean embedding, L2-normalized. Label derived from the 1730 rows nearest that centroid (mean grades: {'scoring': 29.0, 'shooting': 22.1, 'finishing': 78.3, 'ft': 18.2, 'playmaking': 20.9, 'security': 28.4, 'oreb': 87.1, 'dreb': 80.5, 'hands': 34.2, 'rim': 86.3, 'efficiency': 56.3, 'impact': 44.7}).

Label derived from the 1707 rows nearest that centroid (mean grades: {'scoring': 41.5, 'shooting': 50.8, 'finishing': 36.1, 'ft': 55.6, 'playmaking': 86.8, 'security': 46.6, 'oreb': 25.3, 'dreb': 25.9, 'hands': 74.7, 'rim': 25.2, 'efficiency': 38.2, 'impact': 45.9}).

directions.label: Three-point volume (raw stat)
directions.plain: More three-point volume pulls the list toward high-volume three-point shooters, even ones the skill grade alone would miss.
directions.derivation: Stat-group difference vector: FG3A era-z in vectors.json, top decile minus bottom decile (1,297 rows each).

directions.label: Rim pressure / free throws (raw stat)
directions.plain: More free-throw volume pulls the list toward players who live at the rim and draw fouls.
directions.derivation: Stat-group difference vector: FTA era-z in vectors.json, top decile minus bottom decile (1,297 rows each).

provenance: Champion MTNN v5 embeddings (mtnn_embeddings.f32, 12,966 x 64, L2-normalized) index-aligned with vectors.json players and skills.json grades. Slider positions are discrete precomputed steps (alpha -1.0 to +1.0, step 0.2); steering is linear motion in the saved embedding space and is NOT a model rerun.
space_note: Curry 2016-17 -> Ginobili 2009-10 is a 14-d STAT-space Twin Reveal pair. In the 64-d champion embedding space its cosine is 0.4003 and it ranks 390th (person-excluded) -- it is NOT a 64-d top twin. The 64-d top twin of Curry 2016-17 is James Harden 2017-18 (0.8600).
